title: Take a Discovery Flight with Utah Valley Aviation
description: Book a Discovery Flight at Utah Valley Aviation at the Provo Airport: about an hour of flight time with a flight instructor for $150. Request it on their site or call 801-447-7888.
address: Provo Municipal Airport, 3421 Mike Jense Pkwy, Provo, UT 84601

title: 15-Minute Helicopter Tour over Provo, BYU and Y Mountain
description: Utah Helicopter flies a 15-minute tour from the Spanish Fork Airport over Provo, BYU, Y Mountain and Provo Peak. In the R44 it's $69 a seat ($208.07 for all 3 seats). Longer tours include a 45-minute Utah Valley Temple night tour at $215 a seat.
address: Spanish Fork Municipal Airport, Spanish Fork, UT 84660

title: Private Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Flight with Nemesis Balloon Team
description: Nemesis Balloon Team flies private sunrise balloon flights from Utah County spots, including American Fork, Lehi, Lindon, Pleasant Grove and Springville. The private flight is $1,500. Contact them to book and choose a launch spot.
address: Launch site set at booking (American Fork area), UT

title: Learn to Ice Climb in Provo Canyon with Utah Mountain Adventures
description: Take Utah Mountain Adventures' one-day Ice Climbing 1 course in Provo Canyon for $279 plus tax. Groups meet at 7:30am in the Nunn's Park exit lot. Upcoming dates: Dec 12 and 26, Jan 9 and 30, Feb 15 and 27.
address: Nunn's Park, Provo Canyon, UT 84604

title: Drive Through Christmas in Color at Mary & Art Dye Park
description: Drive through the Christmas in Color light show at Mary & Art Dye Park in American Fork, Nov 20–Dec 30, 2026. Tickets start at $34.99 per vehicle.
address: Mary & Art Dye Park, American Fork, UT 84003

title: Sauna and Cold Plunge Contrast Night at Löyly Nordic Spa
description: Löyly Nordic Spa in Orem calls itself home to the largest Finnish sauna in the US, which seats 60, plus 12 cold tubs. Unlimited memberships are $45 a month. Open Mon–Thu 6am–9pm, Fri–Sat 6am–10pm, Sun 8am–2pm.
address: 564 E Park Ave, Orem, UT 84097

title: Paint Splatter and Glass Throwing at Smash It Orem
description: Book a Paint Splatter room, where you fling paint at a canvas, or the Throw Zone for glass throwing at Smash It Rage Rooms on State Street in Orem. Open Mon–Thu 3–10pm, Fri–Sat 11am–11pm, Sun 11am–6pm. Reservations recommended.
address: 170 S State St, Orem, UT 84058

title: Try Fencing at Valkyrie Fencing Club
description: Valkyrie Fencing Club in Pleasant Grove runs an adult session (ages 13+) Tue–Fri 6:30–8:30pm. A trial membership is $100 for 8 sessions, and the beginning fencing class is $150 a month.
address: 560 W State St, Pleasant Grove, UT 84062

title: Drop In to an Aerial Silks Class at Harmony Fitness Studio
description: Take a single aerial silks class together at Harmony Fitness Studio in Orem for $25 per class (ages 14+). The studio also teaches pole.
address: 1431 S State St, Orem, UT 84097

title: Pull a Page on a Gutenberg Press at the Crandall Printing Museum
description: Book a one-hour tour at the Crandall Printing Museum, now at 65 W Main Street Ct in Alpine. Choose the Gutenberg, Benjamin Franklin or Book of Mormon printing tour. Adults are $8. Open by appointment; call 801-500-3099.
address: 65 W Main Street Ct, Alpine, UT 84004

title: Blow a Glass Flower at Holdman Studios
description: Book a one-on-one Basic Glass Flower session at Holdman Studios on Thanksgiving Way in Lehi: up to two colors with a straight or curly stem, working molten glass at 2100°. Ages 10+. Hot-shop pieces need 24 hours to cool, so pick yours up the next day.
address: 3001 N Thanksgiving Way, Lehi, UT 84043

title: Friday Night Silent Disco at Dizzy Disco
description: Put on headphones and pick a channel at Dizzy Disco's Friday silent disco in Provo, 10pm–midnight. General admission is usually $10.

title: Run the Utah Santa Run in Matching Santa Suits
description: Sign up for the Utah Santa Run in Salem on Dec 5, 2026 at 4:15pm: a 5K or 1.55-mile loop around the Salem Pond lights. A Santa suit is included in the $44 entry, and the price goes up after Nov 4.
address: 60 N 100 E, Salem, UT 84653

title: See 'A Krampus Karol' at the Angelus Theatre
description: Catch 'A Krampus Karol', an offbeat Christmas comedy musical thriller in its fifth year at the Angelus Theatre in Spanish Fork. It runs Dec 9–23 at 7:30pm.
address: 165 N Main St, Spanish Fork, UT 84660

title: Come in Costume to the Magical Museum Night at Hutchings
description: Dress up for the Hutchings Museum's Magical Museum night in Lehi: live animals and 'mystical creatures', Nov 20–21, 6–8:30pm. Tickets are $10 per person.
address: 55 N Center St, Lehi, UT 84043

title: Skinwalker Ranch Talk with Ben Woodruff at Hutchings Museum
description: Hear Ben Woodruff talk about Skinwalker Ranch at the Hutchings Museum in Lehi: Nov 6 at 6:00, and Nov 7 at 4:00 and 7:00. Tickets are $10.
address: 55 N Center St, Lehi, UT 84043

title: Rock Out at 'Valhalla | Concert Edition' at the Angelus
description: See the concert version of 'Valhalla | A Nordic Rock Opera' at the Angelus Theatre in Spanish Fork, Nov 12–14 at 7:30pm, performed by past cast members. Come dressed for Asgard.
address: 165 N Main St, Spanish Fork, UT 84660

title: Neo-Soul Night: Moonspyne at the Angelus Theatre
description: See Utah neo-soul band Moonspyne, fronted by Anna Hansen, at the historic Angelus Theatre in Spanish Fork on Nov 7, 7:30–9:30pm. Tickets are $15.
address: 165 N Main St, Spanish Fork, UT 84660

title: Timpanogos Symphony 'O Holy Night' Christmas Concert
description: Hear the Timpanogos Symphony Orchestra's 'O Holy Night' concert at Orem High School, Dec 4–5, 2026 at 7:30pm.
address: Orem High School, 175 S 400 E, Orem, UT 84097

title: Timpanogos Chorale's 'An Old Fashioned Christmas'
description: The Timpanogos Chorale performs 'An Old Fashioned Christmas' at American Fork Junior High on Dec 16 at 7pm. Admission is free; donations welcome.
address: American Fork Jr. High, 20 W 1120 N, American Fork, UT 84003

title: 'It's a Wonderful Life' at the Lehi Arts Center
description: See the Lehi Arts Council's 'It's a Wonderful Life' at the Lehi Arts Center, Dec 4–19 at 7:30pm.
address: 685 N Center St, Lehi, UT 84043

title: Self-Guided Footloose Filming Locations Tour
description: Visit the 1984 'Footloose' filming spots in Utah County from the Utah Film Commission's guide: Lehi Roller Mills, Payson Memorial Park and the American Fork Presbyterian Church. Payson High was torn down in 2025.
address: Lehi Roller Mills, 833 Main St, Lehi, UT 84043

title: Pinball Duel at Nickel Mania Orem
description: Challenge each other on what Nickel Mania calls Utah's largest pinball collection, at 1000 N State St in Orem. Admission is $2.50, and games run on a loadable card. Open Mon–Thu 10am–11pm and Fri–Sat 10am–midnight; closed Sundays.
address: 1000 N State St, Orem, UT 84057

title: Late-Night Board Games at Apothecoffee
description: Apothecoffee, a coffee and tea house in Orem with table games, adds evening hours on Nov 1, 2026: Thu–Sun 7–11pm. Order drinks and play a few games.
address: 360 S State St, Bldg A Ste 148, Orem, UT 84058

title: Bowl a Few Frames at the BYU Bowling & Games Center
description: Bowl at the BYU Bowling & Games Center in the Wilkinson Student Center: $4.50–$6 a game plus $4 shoes. Fall hours: Mon–Thu 1–10pm, Fri 1–11pm, Sat 11am–11pm; closed Sunday.
address: Wilkinson Student Center, BYU, Provo, UT 84602

title: Cheer On UVU Men's Basketball at the UCCU Center
description: Catch a UVU Wolverines men's basketball home game at the UCCU Center in Orem. Home dates run Nov 2, 2026 to Feb 27, 2027.
address: UCCU Center, 800 W University Pkwy, Orem, UT 84058

title: Wander the Hutchings Museum's Oddities in Lehi
description: Browse the Hutchings Museum's exhibits at 55 N Center St in Lehi. Veterans get in for $6. Admission is $8 for ages 13+. Open Tue, Fri and Sat 11–5, and Wed–Thu 11–8.
address: 55 N Center St, Lehi, UT 84043

title: Free Afternoon at the Peteetneet Museum in Payson
description: Tour the Peteetneet Museum and Cultural Arts Center in Payson, housed in the former Peteetneet School (dedicated 1901), with a period classroom exhibit. Admission is free (donations welcome). Open Tue–Fri 10–4 and Sat 10–1.
address: 10 N 600 E, Payson, UT 84651

title: Interfaith Christmas Crèche Exhibit by the Timpanogos Temple
description: Walk through the Interfaith Christmas Crèche Exhibit next to the Mount Timpanogos Temple: crèche displays, a live silhouette nativity and musical performances. Dec 1, 3–9pm, and Dec 2–4, noon–9pm. No tickets are listed.
address: 850 N 900 E, American Fork, UT 84003

title: Visit the Icelandic Monument Lighthouse in Spanish Fork
description: See the 1938 lighthouse monument in Spanish Fork. It honors the first sixteen permanent Icelandic settlers in the United States, who came to Utah in 1855.
address: Icelandic Monument, 400 S 800 E, Spanish Fork, UT 84660

title: Thistle Landslide and Ghost Town Viewpoint
description: Drive US-6 to the Utah Geological Survey's Thistle landslide GeoSight. A pullout on US-6/89 overlooks the 1983 landslide that dammed the Spanish Fork River, flooded both highways and devastated the town of Thistle. Stay at the pullouts; the land around is private or railroad property.
address: US-6 pullout near Thistle, Utah County, UT

title: Volunteer a Shift at the Habitat for Humanity ReStore
description: Volunteer together at Habitat for Humanity of Utah County's ReStore in Orem (open Tue–Sat 10am–6pm; groups up to 15). Build sites require ages 16+. Call 801.344.8527.
address: 340 S Orem Blvd, Orem, UT 84058

title: Sort Food at Tabitha's Way Pleasant Grove Pantry
description: Sign up for a 1–3 hour shift at Tabitha's Way local food pantry, now at 675 W Garden Dr in Pleasant Grove. Volunteers prep for clients, hand out and sort food, and help keep the pantry organized.
address: 675 W Garden Dr #100, Pleasant Grove, UT 84062

title: Become Project Read Literacy Tutors
description: Train as volunteer adult-literacy tutors with Project Read at the Provo City Library. Tutors are 18+ and commit about 3 hours a week for 6 months. There's a $20 refundable materials fee.
address: 550 N University Ave, Suite 215, Provo, UT 84601

title: Hike Silver Lake Trail #036 in American Fork Canyon
description: Hike the 2.3-mile Silver Lake Trail from the north side of Silver Lake Flat Reservoir in American Fork Canyon. It's a summer and fall trail, so check Forest Service conditions and road status before you go.
address: Silver Lake Flat Reservoir, American Fork Canyon, UT
